metadata.title: पत्ते में भूनी गई मछली और बासी भात, लाजवाब ! How to roast fish in tribal style । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen we will take you to the Nilagiri block of Baleshwar district of Odisha. Here we met women of Ho tribe. These women cooked food for us in a very unique style. These women roasted the fish in two ways and hardly few drops of oil was used. Needless to say that the food was not only healthy but very tasty also. Pleas watch and share.
